purpose: Improve absolute prepared-owner endpoint timing and test a genuinely unprofiled service intervention
method_status: full CPU/SoC configuration bound to actual original native build receipts

old_study.old_bit5_target_role: retrospective model-development diagnostic only; not prospective extension validation

service.name: address-bit6-first2-bit7-later1
service.later_wait_countdown: Decrement only while no prior valid read beat is stalled: !r_valid || r_ready
service.exact_oracle_scope: Configured cache fills hold backend ready throughout every transfer; collector asserts no stalled valid beat and exact address-bound first/later intervals
service.arbitrary_backpressure_scope: Accepted later-beat delay cannot be spent while the preceding beat is unaccepted; component gate checks this holding behavior separately
service.selected_link_predicate: read and (address bit6 or (address bit7 and length>0))

absolute.role: existing model comparator on new service

source_repairs: MMIO DATA_ACCEPT -> DATA_COMPLETE minimum 2 instead of 1
CSR/MRET EX_MEM additionally waits for latest older RETIRE + 1
relative.UART_rule_scope: pragmatic frozen-deadline approximation; earlier enqueue dependencies are incomplete

unchanged.formula: original absolute admission/consume edges and original age

primary_metrics: per-case and pooled paired-fast admission phase MAE in CPU rising-clock edges
per-case and pooled paired-fast consume phase MAE in CPU rising-clock edges
original-expected endpoint coverage with fate failures retained
secondary_metrics: full and exposed owner-age exact counts/MAE

cohorts.full: all original retired prepared owners; endpoint failures retained in original-expected coverage
cohorts.phase_affected: original owners for whom either graph forecasts a nonzero admission or consume shift; frozen before target
cohorts.service_age_exposed: original owners linked to a selected original read transaction or assigned nonzero age shift by either graph
cohorts.snapshot: original/target counter-marker fast consumes, separate from full-program denominator

retention.K99: minimum K>=2 capturing at least 99% of positive demand

identity_join.fast_to_slow: fate failure, not a valid predicted fast-consume phase comparison

topology_assumption: Original dependency order, population and residual portability may change; all mismatches remain results

claim_evidence.claim: repaired timing model improves absolute endpoints
claim_evidence.test: full 38 heldout native cases against absolute and unchanged comparators

claim_evidence.claim: relative ages and retention remain useful
claim_evidence.test: all/full exposed owner metrics plus snapshot demand, curves and K99

claim_evidence.claim: input and forecast chronology is prospective
claim_evidence.test: immutable input/source/numeric hashes before parsed-UTC target build/run chronology

coverage_limit: Same nineteen fixed programs under a heldout service; two original short-lived cancellations; no unseen-program or arbitrary-topology guarantee
new_target_policy: Target RTL and collector are prepared and pinned before numerical freeze; no target model compilation, component execution or profiling before complete numeric freeze and independent root review; no target refit
storage: Lossless gzip of completed passed cases only; immutable RESULT raw hashes, full decompressed round-trip hash, compressed hashes and terminal38 storage audit
